verdict.rationale: Three.js's core JS API lets an agent create scenes, nodes, meshes, and materials and edit properties programmatically (documented in llms.txt for LLM consumption), but this is just using the library — there's no evidence of a documented scripting/automation interface for the standalone three.js editor app itself, nor any 'trigger build' concept or API. Missing for 10: documented editor automation/scripting API, evidence of programmatic control of the editor UI, and any build/export trigger mechanism.
